<subject>Re: Kalgoorlie Transport Alliance</subject>
<body>
Adam:

We told James Austin that we would release our Karratha and the Opinion at closing on Wednesday.  They were okay with that.  If that's a problem, I can fax the guaranty and opinion (once I have it signed), with a letter from me saying you can't release it until funding...
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: adam.costa@tasmanridge.com.au
Sent: Tuesday, 30 April 2024 9:59 AM
To: l157@pilbaracoal.com; kenneth.lee@tasmanridge.com.au
Cc: vincent.james@tasmanridge.com.au; todd.vaughan@tasmanridge.com.au
Subject: Kalgoorlie Transport Alliance


Good morning.

In order to finish up Kalgoorlie Transport Alliance tomorrow, please note we need the following today:

Iluka Resources parent guaranty
Loading Facility Certificate (so that full payment can be made to Iluka Resources tomorrow)
Opinion of counsel

And once funds are received by Iluka Resources, we need the receipt of funds letter.

Matthew, I haven't heard back from the Port Hedland gang to find out if the Midwest Vanadium contract is ready.  Maybe Jake can help shake that loose.

Thanks,
Adam
</quoted>
